title: Build Your Personal Website
summary: Use your resume as the source of truth and build a clear, responsive personal website with AI—no coding required.
outcomes: A clear content and visual direction
A reviewed website ready to publish
prerequisites: An account with an AI website builder

modules.title: Plan the website
modules.description: Understand the parts, protect your privacy, and choose a direction.

modules.title: Build and improve
modules.description: Create a grounded prompt, generate a draft, and revise one change at a time.

modules.title: Review and publish
modules.description: Test the experience, publish it, and understand how domains work.
